notes.title: Way's To Support! (CFA Update 1.4/Special News)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141272/920f2c61489b96b67492eab928f4a73e8baeee98.gif[/img]

Hello! I will go on to list some-way's to support in this article! Apart from the reviewers who have gotten permission to review the game, I wanted to let owners of the game know general ways, That will support present, And future developments of this game, And the next projects! So i will be going each of them one by one, And listing website's to visit.

Donations!
This game and future game's can more easily and effortlessly be paid/assisted with the use of money! So anyone with too much income (Preferably those people.) Can direct themselves to "[url=https://ko-fi.com/therealfame]https://shop.cutefame.net[/url]" to pickup a sub, Item, Or an [b]Kofi[/b] to hand over for assisting the writing, And the artists of these game's and projects. This is by far the most chosen way of showing support, But i feel more guilty when this path is chosen.

Reviews!
Do you know, Paying for the game allows you to leave a review on it after playing!?! I know right! This is the best way to express how you feel on things i made, Such as. If you loved it/Liked it, Or wanna see more and wanna get the message of that out to me directly. I highly request you try this out if you have time! (This encourages me to make my game's the most.)

Wishlist's!
The button that does more then people realize! This button help's push the game through more pages on steam, And advertises it with games of the same genre. Helping other's get a chance to be aware of the game! Just like the path below, But more effective. (I'm a huge fan of this path, It's the one i take the most.)

Word Of Mouth
Just talk! No really, Just showing screenshot's, Videos, Or achievement's you unlocked by playing does a lot to make someone consider buying or trying out a game! This is the reason i made the game, Someone made me interested in the game's i played now, And i wanted to design my game, To a similar degree of there's. So this has been a reason i could go on to make this first game without losing motivation for the project.

(What You All Came To See!)

Cute Fames Adventure will be joining the Steam Autumn sale, And i will be giving it off for 30 percent off! No catch. So if you want you're friends to try this game! They can get it for a price that fit's their own needs.

-> I hope you enjoy the game! - [u]Fame[/u]

notes.title: CODENAME: Why Do These Bugs Exist!? (Update 1.3)
notes.content:
[h1]The Update That Fixes Many Things! (Update 1.3)[/h1]
Hello hello! I am just finishing up with update 1.3, Aiming to fix some issues many/myself came across while playing. While also adding a better experience for the player! So, I hope this fixes any soft locks and minor bugs involved with save files on this game, As well as achievements that had been broken. Tell me all about anymore bugs still in the game after this! And they will be fixed asap.
- Fame
